eyebrow.zh: 扫依赖树 · 抓注入 · 护住 Agent
eyebrow.en: Scan deps · Catch injection · Shield your agent

headline.zh:
一条命令
扫出依赖里瞄向 Coding Agent 的注入指令
headline.en:
One command catches the
prompt-injection hiding in your dependencies

sub.zh: 解析你的 npm + PyPI 依赖树，抓取每个包的 README 与文档文本，用一套经过实战沉淀的注入指令规则集逐条比对 —— 命中即报文件、行号、片段、严重级别。jqwik 事件的武器化 README 会被原样标红报出。
sub.en: Resolves your npm + PyPI dep tree, pulls each package's README and doc text, matches a battle-tested injection-payload rule set, and reports file, line, snippet, and severity on every hit. The jqwik incident's weaponized README is flagged red verbatim.

title.zh: 扫的是依赖真正塞进 Agent 上下文的文本
title.en: Scans the text deps actually feed your agent — not version numbers

body.zh: npm 与 PyPI 的 README、包描述、甚至 sdist 里的字符串字面量都会被 Coding Agent 读进上下文。PromptAudit 抓的就是这些文本 —— 武器化依赖藏指令的地方。本地缓存，二次扫描秒回。
body.en: READMEs, package descriptions, even string literals inside sdists get read into your Coding Agent's context. PromptAudit pulls exactly that text — where weaponized deps hide their instructions. Cached locally, so re-scans come back instantly.

chips: › README / 描述 / sdist 字符串

title.zh: 命中的注入指令，直接给到文件、行号、片段
title.en: Every hit points at the file, line, and snippet

body.zh: 不是一句“发现 3 条可疑”——而是精确到哪个包、哪个文件、第几行、带上下文片段。critical 级别直接让 CI 失败，--json 输出给流水线机器消费。
body.en: Not a vague '3 suspicious hits' — but exactly which package, which file, which line, with a context snippet. Critical findings fail CI, and --json hands the pipeline machine-readable output.

title.zh: 拉不下来的包，不再静默“判”干净
title.en: A dep that can't be fetched is never silently scored clean

body.zh: 404 的 yanked 版本、抓取失败的包、被平台 marker 跳过的依赖 —— 全部作为“未扫描”覆盖率缺口暴露在 --json 里，而不是假装扫描通过。--fail-on-fetch-error 让 CI 直接卡在覆盖率上。
body.en: A 404'd yanked version, a failed fetch, a dep skipped by a platform marker — all surface as 'unscanned' coverage gaps in --json, never masquerading as a clean pass. --fail-on-fetch-error gates CI on coverage, not just findings.

title.zh: 审计你真正发布到的平台，不卡在扫描机本身
title.en: Audit the platform you ship to — not the scanner's host

body.zh: Windows 专属依赖、旧 Python 版本依赖默认会被扫描机环境跳过。--target-platform windows / --target-python 3.8 让你从 Linux CI 审计 Windows 安装，跳过的依赖也会作为覆盖率缺口报出来。
body.en: Windows-only deps and old-Python deps get skipped by the scanner host by default. --target-platform windows / --target-python 3.8 audit a Windows install from a Linux CI runner — and skipped deps still surface as coverage gaps.

headline.zh: 装一条命令，挡住武器化依赖
headline.en: Install one command, block weaponized deps

sub.zh: 开源（Apache-2.0）。hosted-CI 版本做 PR 拦截 + 每日 corpus 更新 + MCP server 扫描。
sub.en: Open source (Apache-2.0). The hosted-CI tier adds PR-blocking, daily corpus updates, and MCP-server scanning.

tag.zh: 为 Coding Agent 时代做的依赖扫描
tag.en: Dependency scanning for the Coding Agent era
